purpose: Confidence is about support for an interpretation, never probability that a land-use event occurred or that an antler/forage will be found.

levels.label: High
levels.meaning: Multiple independent lines of evidence agree; alternatives are weaker.
levels.consumerRule: May lead a summary only with alternatives still visible on expand.

levels.label: Moderate
levels.meaning: Evidence points this way; competing stories remain reasonable.
levels.consumerRule: Default ceiling for most field-rule matches without historic imagery.

levels.label: Low
levels.meaning: Thin or ambiguous support; useful for teaching questions.
levels.consumerRule: Lead with suggested observations, not the label.

levels.label: Speculative
levels.meaning: Educational hypothesis pending more looking or data.
levels.consumerRule: Must use hedging; never map as a certified layer.

levels.label: Insufficient
levels.meaning: Do not invent a landscape story from noise.
levels.consumerRule: Surface as Unavailable / keep learning prompts only.

requiredFieldsPerInterpretation: observation linkage or explicit educational-example source
supportingEvidence (may be empty only if status=sample and labeled)

separationContract.observation: What was seen, measured, or cited — no causal claim required.
separationContract.interpretation: Why it might look that way — always provisional.
never: Use percentage certainty in user-facing copy
Confuse species ID with landscape process

alignment.wosConfidence: certain|likely|possible|uncertain map loosely to high|moderate|low|speculative — do not auto-equate without review
alignment.oieTrust: Prefer Estimated / Educational labels until verified sources exist
